description: Erection of a first floor side and rear extension.
decision_conditions: The proposed first floor side and rear rear extension, by virtue of its excessive size, scale,bulk and design, would fail to harmonise with the architectural composition of the original dwelling, would be detrimental to the character, appearance and would unbalance the pair of semi-detached dwellings of which it forms a part. Given the prominence of the side elevation of the property from public views, the proposed extensions would detract from the visual amenities of the street scene and the wider Central Avenue Area of Special Local Character. Therefore the proposal would be contrary to the NPPF (2024), Policies HC1,  D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), Policies BE1 and HE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (2012) and Policies DMHB 1, DMHB 5,  DMHB 11 and DMHB 12  of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020).

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.

We have however been unable to seek solutions to problems arising from the application as the principal of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
